optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Web Frontend Engineer, Developer Tools Platform
professionalSummary: Experienced frontend engineer focused on internal developer console development, test suite ownership, API coordination, and release documentation.
experienceHighlights: Developed and maintained pipeline and artifact views using TypeScript and React, including a virtualised log viewer that replaced full-page log rendering.
Owned component test suite (React Testing Library) and end-to-end suite (Playwright), adding a smoke run to the CI pipeline that blocks releases on failures.
Coordinated API changes with backend team through design reviews, adapting console views to approved endpoint changes.
Authored release notes documenting known limitations and hand‑over conditions for each console release.
Managed console view development, test‑suite ownership, API coordination, and release documentation over approximately two years.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Playwright end‑to‑end suite for the pipeline view and release notes for a console release, with CI pipeline run identifiers as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience in developing console views, owning test suites, coordinating API changes, and documenting releases. They do not provide evidence of a measurable improvement in pipeline‑view load time against the platform’s published performance baseline.

evidence.text: Developed and maintained the pipeline and artifact views of the internal developer console (TypeScript, React), including the virtualised log viewer that replaced the full-page log render.
Owned the component test suite (React Testing Library) and the end-to-end suite (Playwright) for the console, adding a smoke run to the pipeline that blocks releases on failures.

missingEvidence: Evidence of a measurable improvement in pipeline‑view load time reported against the platform’s published performance baseline.

evidence.text: Coordinated API changes with the platform backend team through the API design review; the backend lead approved endpoint changes and I adapted the console views.

Wrote the release notes for each console release, including the known limitation that the artifact view did not paginate repositories with more than ten thousand artifacts, and the hand‑over notes for the on‑call frontend engineer.
